name: Deeper Depravity
notes: Bosses can be raised and used by the player as new lite units: the boss's sprite at a smaller size (to fit through hallways), much less health, normal follow/attack AI and one or two of the boss's own attacks (each boss's real AI is scripted around its arena). Health decays slower than other summons. A boss's intact body is a gray version of the boss, upright (not lying on its side like other bodies). Every boss can be raised: the Harbingers (each judge), the Bandit King (the roaming encounter and the final fight; not his mirror clones), the Bone Serpent, the Spider Queen, Dace Arden, the Avatar, the five Heaven Spirits, the Face, Arista and the four totem poles. Arista and the totem poles can't walk: once in a while they slide toward you like a lunge, with fast acceleration and slow deceleration. How the Face follows you is still open. Left out: the bell ghost shooter in Dace Arden's arena (a prop tagged as a boss).
summary: Increase chance of elite and boss intact bodies
